title: Capability Exchange Document
description: A snapshot of validated capability manifests exchanged between teams, produced by `capability-manifest export`. Each manifest is carried unchanged and must validate against the manifest schema named by its own schemaVersion, so one document can mix schema versions. Mission 4 defines this structure; the inventory content it carries belongs to the capability and inventory owners (Mission 2). The document holds no rankings, approvals, or assessments.

schemaVersions.description: Manifest schema versions used by the capabilities in this document.

notice.description: What structural validity does not establish.

rejected.description: Inputs that failed validation and were left out.

manifest.description: The manifest exactly as authored. Validate it against the manifest schema for its schemaVersion.

warnings.description: Warning codes raised for this manifest.

unverified.description: Checks that could not be confirmed, such as RISK_UNASSESSED.

completeness.description: Completeness level the manifest reaches (see the manifest schema's x-completenessLevels), or 'none'. Consumers must expect partial records.

id.description: id as declared in the rejected manifest, or null.
